activity.notes: Gongmin was the 31st king of Goryeo and reigned from 1351 until his assassination in 1374. His reign coincided with the Yuan-Ming transition and repeated reform efforts aimed at reducing Yuan influence and strengthening royal authority. ATLAS records the sovereign reign only.

sources.title: 공민왕 — 한국민족문화대백과사전
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture identifies Gongmin as Goryeo's 31st king and gives his reign as 1351–1374.
